transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, I'm Dan. How can I help?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi. I want to know how much notice I need to give to cancel my broadband, and whether I'll pay a fee.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, so you'd like to know the notice period for cancelling your broadband and whether there's a fee. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can I take your date of birth?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Look, I don't have all day. Your contract ended in January, so there's no fee, and the notice period is thirty days.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. Can you cancel it for me?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Contract cancellations aren't my job, ring the cancellations line on 0800 900 100.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right. But to be clear: thirty days' notice, and no fee?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct, thirty days and no fee. Is that clear now?
